# Releasing and sharing

Follow the [release checklist](../../../documentation/publishing.md#release-checklist) and report completed steps, evidence, and blockers.
Use the [release notes guide](../../../documentation/release-notes.md) and [writing skill](../writing/SKILL.md) when drafting.
For announcements, follow the [announcement guidance](../../../documentation/publishing.md#announce-the-release) and return drafts with the applicable discussion titles and URLs.
Ask for missing release inputs, and flag claims or links you cannot verify.
The checklist does not authorise remote changes; obtain the user's explicit approval before making any.
